name: Software bill of materials
description: The components a build says it ships, read from the bill of materials it already wrote (CycloneDX or SPDX, in JSON, XML or tag-value) and normalized into one list with the licence each component names.

reports.description: Comma separated globs matched against every file in the working directory and against bare file names, naming the bills of materials to read.

maxComponents.description: Maximum number of components to carry in the facts. The counts still include components that are dropped.

facts.source: `report` when a bill of materials was read, `none` when there was none.
facts.reason: Why nothing was read, present only when `source` is `none`.
facts.reports: Every bill of materials that was read, in path order.
facts.reports[].path: Path of the bill of materials, relative to the directory the CLI runs in.
facts.reports[].modified: When it was last written, ISO 8601, so a bill of materials older than the build is recognisable.
facts.reports[].format: Format it was read as: `cyclonedx` or `spdx`.
facts.format: Format of the first bill of materials read, `cyclonedx` or `spdx`. Each report carries its own in `reports[].format`.
facts.specVersion: Specification version that first bill of materials declares, such as `1.5` or `SPDX-2.3`, or `null` when it declares none.
facts.counts.total: Components across every bill of materials that was read.
facts.counts.licensed: Components naming at least one licence.
facts.licenses: Licence identifier to the number of components naming it. A component naming two licences counts under both.
facts.components[].name: Name of the component, as the bill of materials names it.
facts.components[].version: Version of the component, empty when it carries none.
facts.components[].purl: Package URL of the component, or `null` when it carries none.
facts.components[].type: What the component is, such as `library`, `application` or `container`, or `null`.
facts.components[].licenses: Every licence the component names, by identifier or expression.
facts.dropped: Components left out because `maxComponents` was reached.
